verdict: Page image plus OCR text is a good place to start. On W-2 forms and bank checks, OCR text alone scored lowest (W-2s 0.91 against 0.997; checks 0.89 against 0.994), and the page image alone got every field right on fewer forms (50% of W-2s against 82%). On RealKIE invoices all three scored about the same (0.77 to 0.79). Our image-only runs still paid for OCR; skipping it would save about $10 per 1,000 pages. Test it on your own documents.
